summary: Tested P0 launch-audit fixes: (1) demo tenant provisioning + isolation via POST /api/auth/demo, (2) hidden billing/Pro CTAs when REACT_APP_BILLING_ENABLED=false. All backend (10/10) and frontend checks PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large; consider splitting auth/demo/seed logic into separate modules for maintainability.
In-memory rate limiter for demo/register (10/hr/IP) resets on backend restart — acceptable for demo, but note for production migration to Redis-backed limiter.
data/mock.js still contains jordan@assistify.io string; confirmed dead file per problem statement — recommend deletion in future cleanup pass.
seed_data_creation: TEST_Isolation_Client created via demo1 token during isolation test (contained within throwaway demo org — no cleanup needed as demo orgs are ephemeral per session).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite: /app/backend/tests/test_demo_and_billing.py (10 tests, all pass in ~3s). Covers demo endpoint contract, org isolation (two demos have distinct organizationId; a client created by demo1 is invisible to demo2), seeded workspace (3 clients, 2 projects, 3 tasks, dashboard summary kpis), and regression for /api/auth/login + /api/auth/register. Frontend UI verified: login form fields empty on load, [data-testid=explore-demo-btn] visible, click routes to /dashboard with seeded clients visible, no [data-testid=upgrade-btn] anywhere in sidebar/settings, [data-testid=billing-coming-soon] present in Settings → Billing tab, standard email/password login regression still works. Beware of 10/hr/IP rate limit on register/demo/forgot — restart backend to reset.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in the P0 scope.
